assumptions: All field inputs are canonical; modular reduction is never used as byte-to-field mapping.
Roles, protocol version, shape, and level are distinct control fields whenever an application layout is defined.
BHT/Grover numbers are ideal black-box ceilings only, not security proofs.
No multi-target margin is assigned because target populations and lifetimes are not fixed.
layout: Primitive vectors reserve the final four lanes for role/version/shape/level experiments. No application encoding is defined.
nonAssumptions: CICO resistance does not imply compression-mode security.
Pinned constants do not imply cryptographic approval.
Benchmark performance does not imply deployment eligibility.
